scope: Independent source review of the frozen T1 trackpad enumeration collector against the frozen adapter producer. No collector, adapter, core, layout, DART, SDK, hardware, or SSH change was made. The MIG wrapper was not compiled here.

binding.verification: Recomputed all seven collector hashes, the source-set digest, observation_layout.h, and the eight-file adapter set excluding its receipt. Every value matched the two freeze receipts. Root log runs/m1-desktop-010/trackpad-collector-root-check-001.log reports 4 tests OK in 2.566s. That log is newer than trackpad_collector.c, collector_main.c, both tests, and decode_records.py, and older than README.md and source-validation.json. The logged command does not read README.md. This review did not re-run that command and did not compile collector_main.c.

exit_map.0: ENUMERATION_CAPTURED only when the provider record is well formed, result is 0, and the instance is absent or byte-identical
exit_map.77: REFUSED for every other well-formed record. The numeric result on the verdict line remains 1, -1, -2, -3, or -4
exit_map.1: MISSING, MIG_ERROR, MALFORMED, or INSTANCE_MISMATCH. Missing and MIG do not read the instance. Neither becomes 0 or 77

producer_states_accepted: BEFORE_IO / NOT_ATTEMPTED, masks exactly 0, 1, 3, and 7: keyboard stopped before trackpad I/O, or start failed before enumerate. Exit 77, verdict REFUSED, result=1.
INFO_REQUEST / INFO_REQUEST_FAILED, mask 15, zero metadata: iface2 claim already consumed the key. Exit 77.

INFO_RECEIVED / INFO_INVALID, mask 15, metadata not valid. This includes the frozen host case payload {0,2,0} (m=3, header[1]=2, unread header tail zero) and a full header whose interface is not 2 or whose input is outside 1..2038. Exit 77.

DESC_REQUEST / DESC_REQUEST_FAILED, mask 31, valid iface2 metadata, no descriptor bytes. Exit 77. The frozen transport turns an empty or >512 descriptor reply into this state before enumerateTrackpad sees it.
DESC_RECEIVED / DESC_INVALID, mask 31, valid metadata, stored length 0, payload length 0 or 513..2038. Exit 77. Covers the adapter host cases 0, 513, 2038, and 600.

COMPLETE / ENUM_OK, mask 31, m>=16 with interface byte 2 and input 1..2038, stored length 1..512, payload length equal to stored length, descriptor tail zero. Exit 0. The host success shape m=24, descriptor 90, name byte not present in the 16-byte header, is accepted. Descriptor bytes are not parsed.

closed_short_prefix.previous_rule: m<16 required all 16 header bytes to be zero, so the genuine {0,2,0} publication was MALFORMED exit 1.
closed_short_prefix.frozen_rule: If m<16, only header bytes [m,16) must be zero. Bytes [0,m) are the copied prefix. m<16 cannot be ENUM_OK because valid metadata requires m>=16.

decoder_spot_check.method: Called the frozen decode_records.observation on hand-built 556-byte little-endian records. No C compiler.
rejected: nonzero header byte at index m for m=3
INFO_INVALID whose header is valid iface2 metadata

false_capture_guards: Result 0 is accepted only at stage COMPLETE with mask 31, valid iface2 metadata, stored length 1..512, payload length equal to that length, and a zero descriptor tail.

Provider NO_ENTRY and NO_PROPERTY are both verdict MISSING exit 1. GET_ERROR, including a master-port failure, kIOReturnNotPrivileged, kIOReturnIPCError, and a returned count above 4096, is MIG_ERROR exit 1.
A well-formed provider whose instance is present but differs, has no property, or returns a MIG error is INSTANCE_MISMATCH exit 1, including when result is 0.
Instance NO_ENTRY is the only optional absence. It does not skip validation of the provider record.

The decoder raises on COPY lines, non-556 records, digest or chunk-order failures, input_proven other than false, feature_writes other than 0, and any verdict that disagrees with the raw result. It therefore cannot report ENUMERATION_CAPTURED for a missing, MIG, malformed, or mismatched receipt.

Host mutants each replace one unique token: ENUM_OK check, empty stored descriptor, interface byte, initial exit 1, instance mismatch, descriptor-tail length, and the short-header tail check. Root's log reports those assertion failures without ASan or UBSan diagnostics. This review confirmed the tokens occur once and did not re-run the mutants.
NDEBUG preprocessing of test_collector.c is refused by M1TP_COLLECTOR_TEST_REQUIRES_ASSERTIONS. The log reports that test OK.

findings.title: Instance identity is a fixed registry path, and that path was not executed
findings.conclusion: The provider path IOService:/IOResources matches the personality IOProviderClass and preserve()'s provider->setProperty. The instance path is IOService:/IOResources/PDM1SPIHID. fromPath walks child names; getName() uses the meta-class name when no name property is set; the adapter and keyboard sources do not call setName; IOClass is PDM1SPIHID. The kernel from_path routine returns success even when the entry is NULL, and the wrapper maps that to NO_ENTRY. A live instance under any other name is therefore reported absent. Exit 0 does not require the instance to be present, so a result-0 provider record would still be ENUMERATION_CAPTURED and the equality check would not run. Those two copies are one preserve() of the same bytes, so a missed name does not invent a second observation. It can mislabel a live instance as absent, and a second child with the same name would not be fail-closed: getChildFromComponent returns the first match. The one-shot probe makes a second live instance unlikely. None of this was executed.
findings.action: During the SDK and producer-binding review, confirm this path resolves to the live PDM1SPIHID instance after a successful start, and that a failed start leaves the instance absent while IOResources still holds the property. No collector edit is required before that confirmation. If the runtime name differs, switch the instance read to a class match with a second-match failure, as the qualified DART collector does, and keep absence meaning detach rather than lookup miss.

checked_not_defects.title: REFUSED is the umbrella token for every well-formed nonzero result
checked_not_defects.conclusion: NOT_ATTEMPTED (result 1) exits 77 with verdict REFUSED. The same line prints result=1. The decoder requires that pairing. Missing bytes do not use this token. A consumer distinguishes not-attempted from a device refusal by the numeric result, not by the word REFUSED.

checked_not_defects.title: In-band count is 4096, not 556
checked_not_defects.conclusion: io_registry_entry_get_property_bytes copies an object when the supplied count is at least its length, and otherwise returns kIOReturnIPCError with no copy. The wrapper passes 4096. A property of 557..4096 bytes is copied, emitted, and then rejected as MALFORMED exit 1. A longer property is MIG_ERROR exit 1. Neither is capture or refusal. The decoder accepts only bytes=556. Passing 556 would refuse the longer object in the kernel; the current exit map is already closed.

checked_not_defects.title: input_proven=false and feature_writes=0 are constants
checked_not_defects.conclusion: Every verdict line prints both, and the decoder rejects any other value. They are policy statements. feature_writes is not a field of the 556-byte record and is not counted from the registry. The descriptor is acquired bytes only.

checked_not_defects.title: kIOReturnNoResources compare and missing IOKIT guard
checked_not_defects.conclusion: The wrapper compares kern_return_t with (kern_return_t)0xe00002be, which is the kernel's property-absent code. On the two's-complement ARM64 ABI that preserves the bits. There is no #error if -DIOKIT=1 -DKERNEL=0 -UKERNEL is omitted; io_struct_inband_t is then undefined, so the wrapper fails to compile. The prototypes used are the generated device_user.h routines, not a handwritten declaration. IOMasterPort is called once. Each read releases its send right. There is no IOServiceOpen, IOConnect, setProperty, HID, or retry.

checked_not_defects.title: Attached instance without the property
checked_not_defects.conclusion: If preserve() records the provider copy and the instance setProperty fails, and that instance is still attached, the collector returns INSTANCE_MISMATCH exit 1. It does not turn that record into a refusal or a capture. After a normal failed start detaches the instance, the provider copy with NO_ENTRY is exit 77 for a nonzero result and exit 0 only for a complete result.

out_of_scope: core/m1tp_enum.h still leaves its two-argument M1TP_ASSERT defined. observation_layout.h defines and undefines a one-argument macro of the same name. The frozen adapter includes the layout header first, so T1 does not need a core edit. A later core revision can undefine M1TP_ASSERT at the end of m1tp_enum.h. This review did not change that header.
